findings.what: every landing-door head is bounded ABOVE by a drawn ring beam on the door side (GF roof B14 20x75, 1F roof B7 20x75, 2F roof B2 20x40; DXF marks 45F / 6CC / 78A, schedule p.10): GF <= 3.70 (3.75 at b = 0), 1F <= 3.40 (3.45), 2F <= 3.80 - r. No printed value bounds it BELOW: the height stays HELD, never a default

the candidate paint / plaster lines (G1 face heights GF 3.65, 1F 3.35, 2F 3.35) all sit at or below those soffits: the drawn members do NOT narrow 1F-13 / 2F-01 / GF-08 (0.000 m2); only the note-19 GF tie-beam reading would (GF-08 low end +0.65 m2 per line) and its sides are not drawn (SCENARIO, structural RFI item 38)

for T-558 (Q-72 plaster to the slab soffit): an opening under a member of overall depth D in a slab t can never deduct the (D - t) band: GF 0.59, 1F 0.59, 2F 0.24 m2 per landing face stay plastered whatever the head (1.00 m wide); independent of b / r

T-608's text census could not see ST p.8 (raster) or ST p.14 (vector, no text layer): note 19 and the p.14 'Lift door' / 'As Per Lift Manufactures recommendations' leaders exist on the PDF only; a DXF-only census is not a census of the set (lesson row proposed)
